trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened and what I did:

**Problem:** After the latest deploy, checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks across all production regions — service unhealthy with a ~18% error rate.

**Action taken:**
1. Checked release history — the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. Rolled back checkout-api to **v2.3.0 in all regions** (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
3. Verified post-rollback health: service is **healthy**, error rate dropped from ~18% to ~0.2%.
4. Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** titled "checkout-api v2.3.1 unhealthy — rolled back to v2.3.0" describing the failure and the rollback, with the on-call engineer paged. (The first incident-creation request hit a timeout, so I verified no incident had been created and retried with the same idempotency key to avoid duplicates.)

No additional approval was needed since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production. The service is currently stable; you may want a follow-up investigation into what broke in v2.3.1 before it's redeployed.
